content.title: Newly-Listed Sionna Therapeutics Touts Positive Data From Lung Disease Candidate In Healthy Volunteer Trial
content.summary: Sionna Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:SION) released data from its Phase 1 trials of SION-719 and SION-451, the company’s first-in-class nucleotide-binding domain 1 (NBD1) stabilizers, in healthy volunteers. One hundred subjects were dosed in the SION-719 trial, and 110 subjects were dosed in the SION-451 trial.
